plan: Poochyena threatens Sucker Punch while Zigzagoon Belly Drums into Extreme Speed; Helping Hand boosts the boosted priority or Guts Taillow's finishing attacks. The reserves extend that opening: Starly supplies Brave Bird.
crack: Protect or Fake Out the Drum turn, hit Zigzagoon at half HP with anything, and answer Taillow with Rock or Electric; Intimidate ruins the whole plan.

plan: Spinarak slows both active opponents with Electroweb or a single target with Toxic Thread, supporting Sturdy Dwebble and No Guard Karrablast immediately. The reserves extend that opening: Dewpider supplies Liquidation.
crack: Ground blocks Electroweb, Taunt blocks Toxic Thread, and special Fire pressure breaks the bugs without caring about their physical bulk.

plan: Light Ball Pikachu Fake Outs while Paras Spores, buying the Choice Band Slakoth free Truant turns to swing Hammer Arm and Body Slam. The reserves extend that opening: Bunnelby supplies Quick Attack.
crack: Grass types, Overcoat and Safety Goggles laugh at Spore, Ground answers Pikachu, and Protect on Slakoth's active turn wastes half its life.

plan: Skitty Fake Outs and Sings so Swirlix can eat its Sitrus Berry, Unburden into double speed and fire Draining Kiss and coverage. The reserves extend that opening: Eevee supplies Quick Attack; Taillow supplies Facade.
crack: Steel or Poison walls Swirlix, Taunt stops Skitty's Sing, and any priority move erases Swirlix once it is in Sitrus range.

plan: Lotad sets rain for Swift Swim Muddy Water and Wingull's perfect Hurricane, and Billy's Choice Scarf Ditto copies whatever the player is proudest of. The reserves extend that opening: Tandemaus supplies Population Bomb.
crack: Electric and Rock crush the rain pair; Ditto copies a Pokemon with Struggle-bait PP or one that is weak to its own STAB.

plan: Chinchou paralyzes with Thunder Wave so Choice Band Corphish and Dragon Dance Barboach out-tempo the board. The reserves extend that opening: Clamperl supplies Shell Smash.
crack: Grass threatens the entire core. Ground blocks paralysis, and immediate pressure on Barboach denies its Dragon Dance window.

plan: Intimidate Snubbull and Milcery's Helping Hand turn Fur Coat Furfrou into a U-turn pivot that nothing physical can dent. The reserves extend that opening: Slakoth supplies Body Slam.
crack: Furfrou is only physically bulky; special attackers, Steel and Poison go through the fairies, and Taunt stops Cotton Guard.

plan: Nymble opens with First Impression and Sucker Punch while Overcoat Sewaddle chips with Struggle Bug. The reserves extend that opening: Karrablast supplies Megahorn; Shuckle supplies Rock Tomb.
crack: Fire, Flying and Rock end both bugs; First Impression only works on the turn Nymble switches in.

plan: Aqua's Speed Boost Carvanha snowballs behind Wailmer's Water Spout and Icy Wind, while Grimer removes items and finishes with Shadow Sneak. Poochyena supports the remaining attacker with Helping Hand and weakens special attacks with Snarl.
crack: Electric or Grass punishes both Water types, Carvanha dies to any hit, and Icy Wind is only a problem if the player lets Carvanha boost twice.

plan: Surskit lays Sticky Web and sets rain, Speed Boost Venipede Protects into a snowball, and Water Bubble Dewpider hits like a truck for its level. The reserves extend that opening: Kricketune supplies Bug Bite.
crack: Flying and Levitate ignore the Web, Fire and Rock hit the bugs, and Venipede is frail before it boosts.

plan: Winston's expensive Porygon reads the board with Download while No Guard Honedge uses Swords Dance beside Porygon's coverage. Gimmighoul stays in reserve as the ace, using Substitute against passive targets. The reserves extend that opening: Wooloo supplies Cotton Guard.
crack: Fighting threatens Porygon, Fire and Ghost threaten Honedge, and Taunt shuts off the setup options without disabling the team's attacks.

plan: Eevee uses Wish for itself or a replacement and pressures targets with Adaptability Double-Edge. Ralts provides paralysis and special pressure; Huge Power Marill supplies physical Fairy damage and priority. The reserves extend that opening: Snubbull supplies Play Rough.
crack: Any strong physical attacker walks through both; Ralts folds to Bug or Ghost.

plan: The twins run pairs: Plus and Minus power each other up, then Prankster Volbeat Tail Glows and Baton Passes into Illumise's Dazzling Gleam.
crack: Ground shuts down the Electric pair, Taunt stops the Baton Pass chain, and spread Rock or Flying damage ends the bugs.

plan: Tentacool's Icy Wind and Acid Spray set up Deep Sea Tooth Clamperl's Shell Smash while Strong Jaw Chewtle crunches. The reserves extend that opening: Chinchou supplies Thunder Wave.
crack: Electric hits all three, Grass hits two, and Clamperl at minus one defense dies to any physical hit after the Smash.

plan: Prankster Riolu Coaches its partner before anything moves, so Pure Power Meditite and Iron Fist Crabrawler swing at plus one. The reserves extend that opening: Clobbopus supplies Brick Break.
crack: Flying and Psychic hit the fighters, Haze or Clear Smog wipes the Coaching, and Riolu is one hit from gone once its Sash breaks.

plan: Hector collects rivals: Toxic Boost Zangoose and Infiltrator Seviper attack side by side while Spinda buys turns with Fake Out and locks exposed setup or protection moves with Encore. The reserves extend that opening: Porygon supplies Tri Attack.

plan: Spoink calls Trick Room for Regenerator Slowpoke and Levitate Baltoy, who become the fastest things on the field. The reserves extend that opening: Gothita supplies Psychic.
crack: Dark and Ghost hit all three, Taunt on Spoink stops the Room, and Protect stalls the turns away.

crack: Fighting and Rock hit the Normal types, Ground answers Pawmi, and Rocky Helmet punishes Population Bomb on every contact, while Protect blocks it for a turn.

plan: Both Wurmple paths: Dustox sets Tailwind and heals while Beautifly Quiver Dances under it, and Technician Kricketune Taunts. The reserves extend that opening: Venipede supplies Protect.
crack: Rock, Fire and Flying hit every bug, Taunt Beautifly before it dances, and the Tailwind is only four turns long.

plan: Clark's cave crew: Roggenrola sets Stealth Rock and Body Presses behind Iron Defense, Rock Head Geodude Double-Edges freely without hitting its partner, and Stamina Mudbray grows tougher with every hit. The reserves extend that opening: Archen supplies Rock Slide.
crack: Water and Grass hit everything, Mudbray's Stamina does nothing against special attacks, and Geodude is telegraphed when it is the last one standing.

plan: Johnson's Sinnoh trio: Intimidate Shinx softens the board, Reckless Starly Brave Birds, and Huge Power Bunnelby U-turns out of trouble. The reserves extend that opening: Taillow supplies Facade.
crack: Rock hits Starly, Ground hits Shinx, and Fighting or Steel handles the rabbit; Starly's recoil does half the work for you.

plan: Hippopotas brings sand for Sand Rush Drilbur, Yawns to force switches, and Sturdy Aron soaks hits while the sand chips. The reserves extend that opening: Cranidos supplies Head Smash.
crack: Water and Grass ignore the sand plan, Rock and Steel types take no sand damage, and Drilbur is only fast while the sand lasts.

plan: Dawson's imported pets: Tough Claws Galarian Meowth, a Rookidee that Taunts and Brave Birds, and Fluffy Wooloo behind Cotton Guard. The reserves extend that opening: Tandemaus supplies Population Bomb.
crack: Fire beats Wooloo and Meowth, Electric and Rock drop Rookidee, and Taunt stops Wooloo from setting up.

plan: Sarah's Spritzee sets Trick Room so slow Gothita and Fidough move first, with Fake Tears making Psychic land like a nuke. The reserves extend that opening: Baltoy supplies Earth Power.
crack: Steel and Poison wall the fairies, Taunt stops the Room, and Protect burns its turns.

plan: Pichu Fake Outs and Nuzzles so Huge Power Marill's Aqua Jet and Play Rough clean up. The reserves extend that opening: Swirlix supplies Draining Kiss; Chewtle supplies Liquidation.
crack: Grass and Electric threaten Marill, Ground threatens Pichu, and Pichu breaks on any contact.

plan: Jerry's science project: Sturdy Magnemite paralyzes and pivots, and Air Balloon Varoom floats over Ground moves to Taunt and Gunk Shot. The reserves extend that opening: Skrelp supplies Dragon Pulse; Grimer supplies Poison Jab.
crack: Fire beats both Steel types; pop the Balloon with any hit and Ground crushes Varoom.

plan: Josh guards the door with a wall of Sturdy: Bonsly and Shieldon refuse to fall in one hit and answer with Counter, Rolycoly spins hazards away and rides Steam Engine, Nacli Recovers, and Alolan Geodude uses partner-safe Electric and Ground coverage.
crack: Sturdy only holds from full HP, so any chip or a spread move on turn one collapses the whole wall; Fighting, Ground, Grass and Water all hit this team hard, and nothing here outruns a healthy lead.

crack: Fake Out only works on the turn a Pokemon comes in, so a Protect or a switch blanks it; Flying and Psychic hit everything here, and Mankey is locked into whatever it picked.

crack: Every locked attacker can be walled by the type it did not pick; Machop is fragile, Riolu dies to anything, and Fluffy Stufful takes double from Fire.

crack: Defiant and Competitive turn her Intimidate into your boost; Fairy and Flying answer the Dark types, and Meditite falls to a stiff breeze.

plan: Takao does not let you leave: Grapploct's Octolock pins a target and strips it every turn, Shadow Tag Wobbuffet makes switching impossible at all, and White Herb Hitmonlee sheds its drops to become Unburden fast.
crack: Octolock and Shadow Tag both miss Ghosts entirely; Wobbuffet cannot attack on its own terms, and Poliwrath is the only thing here that resists your Water.

plan: Cristian's room is one combo: Falinks fires Beat Up at its own partner, every hit triggers Justified on Gallade and Lucario alike, and the Attack it stacks turns Close Combat into a sweep while No Guard Machamp's Dynamic Punch never misses behind it.
crack: Beat Up only helps if Gallade is on the field, so knocking one half of the pair out ends the trick; Falinks itself is slow, Flying and Fairy hit almost everyone, and Annihilape's Rage Fist is weak until you have hit it a few times.

plan: Jocelyn is the last door before Brawly: Prankster Whimsicott opens beside Combusken, with Volbeat able to renew Tailwind later, and Speed Boost Combusken, Poison Heal Breloom and Choice Band Crabominable run you down underneath it.
crack: Tailwind runs out after four turns and Prankster does nothing to a Dark type; Whimsicott and Volbeat are made of paper, and Breloom without its Toxic Orb is just a frail Grass type.

plan: Pachirisu redirects attacks and spreads paralysis while Choice Band Heracross threatens Moxie. Guts Conkeldurr and Fake Out Hariyama sustain physical pressure. crack: Spread attacks bypass Follow Me, and removing Pachirisu opens the attackers to focused damage. Intimidate and burns threaten the ordinary physical attackers but not every member equally; Guts and Justified punish careless status or Dark attacks.

plan: Flaaffy sets both screens and Electrowebs, Huge Power Marill and Tympole pressure behind them, and Wartortle Shell Smashes once the field is slow.
crack: Screen Cleaner, Brick Break or Defog erase the screens, Grass and Electric hit the Water types, and Wartortle after a Smash dies to any strong hit.

crack: Psychic and Ground hit Koffing, Rock and Electric hit the other two, and Staravia locked into Brave Bird kills itself with recoil.

plan: Ethan's Soundproof Bouffalant Head Charges and Grassy Surge Rillaboom Drum Beats behind priority Grassy Glide. The reserves extend that opening: Cacturne supplies Seed Bomb; Dhelmise supplies Anchor Shot.
crack: Fighting hits Bouffalant, Fire and Flying hit Rillaboom, and both are slow once Grassy Glide's priority is denied by a Flying type.

plan: Shuckle sets Sticky Web or boosts Seviper with Helping Hand; Seviper spreads paralysis and special pressure. Sniper Drapion punishes openings, Milotic can clear opposing boosts, and Mega Absol returns hostile status with Magic Bounce.
crack: Fire and Rock hit Shuckle and Drapion, Psychic and Ground hit Seviper, Electric and Grass hit Milotic, and Fighting or Fairy ends Absol; Flying types ignore the Web.

plan: Expert Shelby reads stances: Wobbuffet traps and Encores, Regenerator Slowbro Psyshocks, Stance Change Aegislash King's Shields, and Mega Medicham's Pure Power Fake Out and High Jump Kick close.
crack: Ghost types walk out of Shadow Tag, Dark hits Slowbro and Aegislash's blade form, Flying and Fairy hit Medicham, and High Jump Kick crashes into Protect.

plan: Beauty Melissa's Lopunny Switcheroos its Toxic Orb onto the player's best Pokemon, Liquid Voice Primarina spreads Water Hyper Voice, and Trace Gardevoir copies an Ability. The reserves extend that opening: Wigglytuff supplies Hyper Voice.
crack: Fighting hits Lopunny, Electric and Grass hit Primarina, Steel and Poison hit Gardevoir, and Protect blocks the Switcheroo.

plan: Sheila's royal court blocks priority: Queenly Majesty Tsareena, Skill Link Cinccino with a King's Rock, and Overcoat Escavalier Swords Dancing behind an Occa Berry. The reserves extend that opening: Wormadam supplies Quiver Dance.
crack: Fire hits Tsareena and Escavalier, Fighting hits Cinccino, and Tsareena's Queenly Majesty does nothing against ordinary attacks.

plan: Shirley's summit performance: Alcremie Decorates its partner, Screen Cleaner Galarian Mr. Mime Freeze-Dries with a Choice Scarf, and Pixilate Sylveon Calm Minds into Hyper Voice. The reserves extend that opening: Slowbro supplies Psyshock.
crack: Steel and Poison hit Alcremie and Sylveon, Ghost and Steel hit Mr. Mime, and Haze or Clear Smog erases Decorate.

plan: Sawyer's Sand Stream Gigalith and Sand Rush Excadrill: one sets the storm, the other doubles its speed inside it. The reserves extend that opening: Camerupt supplies Heat Wave; Donphan supplies High Horsepower.
crack: Water and Grass hit Gigalith, Fire, Fighting and Ground hit Excadrill, and the sand lasts only five turns.

plan: Cole guards the first chamber with skin you should not touch: Flame Body Fletchinder burns anything that makes contact, Rocky Helmet Torracat charges you for the privilege, and Tough Claws Heatmor punishes the same range you had to step into.
crack: Special attacks make no contact at all, so Water, Rock and Ground from range walk straight through; almost everything here is a first stage propped up by its item.

plan: Gerald brings the sun by hand: Sunflora turns on Sunny Day and Chlorophyll doubles the speed of everything behind it, Solar Beam fires the same turn it is called, and Mega Charizard X stops being a Fire type you can answer with Water alone.
crack: Rain, sand or snow cancel the whole plan, and Sunny Day only lasts five turns without a Heat Rock; Victreebel and Sunflora are slow and frail before the sun is up.

plan: Axle wants you to swing: Weakness Policy Armarouge doubles both attacking stats the moment a super effective hit lands, Steam Engine Coalossal turns your Water move into speed, and Flash Fire makes your Fire move useless.
crack: Status, hazards and forced switches never trigger any of it; Ceruledge's Weak Armor cuts its own Defence, and Turtonator explodes its own shell if you hit it physically.

plan: Keegan poisons himself on purpose: Guts Flareon Facades off its own Toxic Orb, Reckless Emboar throws its whole body into every hit, and Typhlosion's Eruption is at full power while its health is.
crack: Eruption falls off a cliff the moment Typhlosion is damaged, recoil finishes half this team for you, and Vigoroth is the only thing here that resists nothing at all.

plan: Oricorio can set up Quiver Dance and copy allied dances; Mega Blaziken supplies Speed Boost and Swords Dance pressure. Kubfu and Sizzlipede bring physical coverage, while Rotom and Blaze Delphox attack from the special side.
crack: Do not dance at all and Oricorio is a frail Flying type; Blaziken needs turns it does not have against Water or Psychic, and Kubfu is still a first stage.

plan: Eli builds the floor under the fire: Claydol and Bronzong float above Ground and shrug off Fire with Levitate and Heatproof, Mega Camerupt answers the Water that answers them, with Sheer Force behind it, and Intimidate Arcanine takes the edge off everything physical.
crack: Bronzong and Claydol are both painfully slow and fold to Ghost, Dark and Fire from range; Camerupt is four times weak to Water, and Rapidash has no bulk at all.

plan: Jace poisons what cannot be poisoned: Corrosion Salazzle lands Toxic on Steel and Poison types alike, Hisuian Arcanine and Alolan Marowak bring typings the gym has not shown you, and Hisuian Typhlosion burns the spirit rather than the body.
crack: Toxic takes time Salazzle may not get -- it dies to one strong hit; Ground, Rock and Water hit almost everyone, and Larvesta and Lampent are both still growing.

plan: Jeff is the last door and he moves first: Gale Wings Talonflame gets priority on Brave Bird at full health, Libero Cinderace becomes whatever type it needs, Iron Fist Infernape answers with Mach Punch, and Choice Scarf Darmanitan outruns the rest.
crack: Chip Talonflame once and Gale Wings switches off; Rock answers three of them, Drifblim is slow, and every Choice item here is a commitment you can wall.

plan: Drought Torkoal and Chlorophyll Lilligant open with After You into Eruption; Heat Wave preserves partner safety once Torkoal loses HP. Lilligant threatens Water answers with Leaf Storm and disrupts with Sleep Powder. Incineroar uses Fake Out, Intimidate and Parting Shot to create more attacking turns, while Skeledirge, Entei and Mega Chandelure sustain the sun offense.
crack: Changing weather removes Chlorophyll and weakens Fire attacks. Wide Guard, priority damage into Torkoal, or disrupting Lilligant can break the opening. Fire-resistant opponents and careful switching can survive the sun, but must respect the Grass coverage.

plan: Drew's desert traps: Stakataka sets Trick Room and Wide Guards, Iron Fist Golurk punches first inside it, and Water Absorb Cacturne Sucker Punches whatever tries to move before the Room. The reserves extend that opening: Perrserker supplies Iron Head.
crack: Water and Grass hit Cacturne's partners and Fighting hits Stakataka, Taunt stops the Room, and Protect burns its turns.

plan: Heidi's oasis: Shaymin from Route 117 fires Seed Flare, Contrary Lurantis grows with Superpower, and Stamina Mudsdale gets tougher with every hit. The reserves extend that opening: Parasect supplies Spore.
crack: Fire and Flying hit Shaymin and Lurantis, Water and Grass hit Mudsdale, and special attacks ignore Stamina.

plan: Beau found a Kartana in Petalburg Woods: it slices behind a Sash while Storm Drain Gastrodon absorbs Water and Tough Claws Dusk Lycanroc leads with Accelerock. The reserves extend that opening: Archeops supplies Acrobatics.
crack: Fire ends Kartana in one hit, Grass quadruples on Gastrodon, and Water, Grass or Fighting drops Lycanroc.

plan: Ruin Maniac Dusty dug up Ting-Lu in the Desert Underpass: its Vessel of Ruin halves everyone's Sp. Atk while it Ruinations, Magic Guard Sigilyph hits from above, and Bastiodon sets rocks and Metal Bursts. The reserves extend that opening: Aurorus supplies Hyper Voice.
crack: Fighting, Grass, Water and Ice hit Ting-Lu; Rock and Electric hit Sigilyph; Fighting and Ground quadruple on Bastiodon.

plan: Daisuke's doubles dojo: Pure Power Medicham, Lucario with Extreme Speed and Swords Dance, and Fluffy Bewear behind an Assault Vest. The reserves extend that opening: Annihilape supplies Rage Fist.
crack: Flying, Psychic and Fairy hit all three, Fire hits Bewear and Lucario, and Medicham cannot take a hit.

plan: Alannah met Celebi in Petalburg Woods: it pivots with U-turn and Giga Drains, Grassy Surge Trevenant heals the field and Leech Seeds, and Mega Venusaur's Thick Fat shrugs off Fire and Ice. The reserves extend that opening: Gourgeist supplies Shadow Ball.
crack: Fire, Flying, Bug and Ice hit the Grass core, Ghost and Dark hit Celebi and Trevenant, and Taunt stops the seeding.

plan: Martin's Drought Ninetales lights the sun for Chlorophyll Leafeon's Leaf Blade. The reserves extend that opening: Centiskorch supplies Fire Lash; Cacturne supplies Sucker Punch.
crack: Rock and Ground hit Ninetales, Fire and Flying hit Leafeon, and rain or sand ends the plan.

plan: Roman found a Buzzwole in the Ashen Woods: it Close Combats and drains, Natural Cure Starmie controls speed, and Weakness Policy Golem wants to be hit by Water. The reserves extend that opening: Rhydon supplies Rock Slide.
crack: Flying and Psychic hit Buzzwole, Dark and Electric hit Starmie, and Grass hits Golem without triggering its Policy.

plan: Wo-Chien's Tablets of Ruin reduces other Pokemon's Attack by a quarter while Intimidate Masquerain sets up Quiver Dance. Araquanid supplies Wide Guard and Water Bubble offense; Bronzong contributes Light Screen and Body Press without relying on its reduced Attack.
crack: Fire, Bug and Flying hit Wo-Chien and Masquerain, Electric and Rock hit Araquanid, Dark hits Bronzong, and Taunt stops both the Room and the Dance.

plan: Justin's Protean Kecleon Fake Outs and Shadow Sneaks while Contrary Malamar Superpowers and Topsy-Turvies the player's boosts. The reserves extend that opening: Bouffalant supplies Head Charge; Cacturne supplies Seed Bomb.
crack: Fighting hits Kecleon, Bug and Fairy hit Malamar, and Intimidate on Malamar only makes it stronger, so use special attacks.

plan: Martha's doubles: Competitive Meowstic Calm Minds, Magic Guard Clefable Calm Minds too, and Mega Banette's Prankster Will-O-Wisp and Destiny Bond end things. The reserves extend that opening: Gourgeist supplies Shadow Ball.
crack: Dark hits Meowstic and Banette, Steel and Poison hit Clefable, and Taunt stops every Calm Mind and the Bond.

plan: Alan's rock wall: Lightning Rod Rhydon soaks Electric, Water Compaction Palossand hardens under Water, and Mega Aggron's Filter shrugs off super-effective hits. The reserves extend that opening: Golem supplies Rock Slide.
crack: Grass hits all three, Fighting and Ground hit Aggron and Rhydon, and Water is the one thing Palossand wants you to click.

plan: Randall opens with the answer to every safety net: Skill Link Cinccino and Maushold hit five times a turn, so Sturdy, Focus Sashes and Substitutes all break in one move, and Technician Ambipom's Double Hit does the same for less.
crack: Multi-hit moves are weak per strike, so anything with real Defence simply eats them; Fighting hits four of the six, and Ambipom is locked into its choice.

plan: Parker makes one Pokemon act twice: Oranguru's Instruct hands its partner a second turn on the spot, Armor Tail Farigiraf switches your priority off entirely, and Trick Room turns his slowest bodies into his fastest.
crack: Trick Room lasts five turns and Oranguru is the only setter, so Taunt or Encore ends the room; Dark answers three of them and Bug answers the rest.

plan: George does not try to beat you, he tries to outlast you: Eviolite Chansey and Regenerator Audino heal faster than most teams do damage, Comatose Komala cannot be put to sleep or poisoned at all, and Fluffy Dubwool halves every contact hit.
crack: None of this threatens you, so setup, Taunt or a Fighting move ends the stall; Fluffy doubles damage from Fire, and Chansey folds to anything physical that hits hard once.

plan: Scrappy Exploud spreads partner-safe Hyper Voice while Mega Glalie uses Refrigerate Facade and Ice Shard. Steely Spirit Perrserker supports Steel damage, Intimidate Stoutland controls physical pressure, and Kangaskhan supplies Fake Out and safe coverage.
crack: Rock and Steel resist Normal damage, and targeted special attacks bypass the physical defensive tools. Deny Glalie free attacks and break Kangaskhan's Fake Out momentum.

plan: Mary punishes you for winning exchanges: Berserk Drampa doubles its Special Attack the moment it drops below half, Sheer Force Rufflet trades its secondary effects for raw power, and Guts Obstagoon wants the burn you were going to inflict.
crack: Knock her below half in one hit instead of two and Berserk never fires; Fighting and Rock hit most of the team, and Silvally without a memory is only a Normal type.

plan: Alexia poisons and burns her own team on purpose: Toxic Boost Zangoose and Guts Ursaring turn their status into raw Attack, Gluttony Linoone Belly Drums and then Extreme Speeds, and Simple Bibarel gets two stages from every Curse.
crack: Every orb holder is on a clock and takes damage each turn; Belly Drum leaves Linoone at a quarter health, and Normalize makes Delcatty's whole moveset resisted by Rock and Steel.

plan: Jody is the last door and she does not bother with tricks: Huge Power Diggersby hits harder than anything else in the chapter, Mega Pinsir grows with every knockout, Intimidate Tauros blunts you on the way in, and Adaptability Porygon-Z closes from range.
crack: Diggersby is slow and locked into one move; Fighting, Water and Grass answer most of the team, and Pinsir gets nothing if you never let it take a kill.

plan: Indeedee redirects under Psychic Terrain while Porygon2 applies Icy Wind, giving Norman's bulky attackers time to act. Meloetta spreads Hyper Voice, Bewear absorbs physical pressure, and Choice Band Slaking uses partner-safe Ground coverage. Mega Staraptor can Protect through an exposed turn before committing to its powerful contact attacks.
crack: Remove Indeedee to regain direct access to its partner, and replace Psychic Terrain to recover grounded priority. Fighting attacks threaten much of the team, while Protect on Slaking's active turns exploits Truant. Special attacks avoid Bewear's physical resilience.

plan: Cora's doubles: Dry Skin Toxicroak Swords Dances, Regenerator Mienshao Fake Outs and U-turns, and Defiant Annihilape's Rage Fist grows every time it is hit. The reserves extend that opening: Gurdurr supplies Drain Punch.
crack: Psychic and Flying hit all three, Fairy hits Annihilape and Toxicroak, and Rage Fist only grows if the player keeps hitting it instead of switching.

plan: Yuji trains with a Type: Null from Route 118: Battle Armor blocks crits while it Icy Winds and U-turns, Intimidate Scrafty Fake Outs and Quick Guards, and Thick Fat Hariyama Close Combats. The reserves extend that opening: Lucario supplies Close Combat.
crack: Fighting hits Type: Null and Scrafty is weak to Fairy, Flying and Fighting; Psychic and Flying hit Hariyama.

plan: Paula's doubles: Poison Heal Breloom Spores behind Substitute for Focus Punch, Scrappy Pangoro Parting Shots, and Belly Drum Poliwrath. The reserves extend that opening: Crabominable supplies Close Combat.
crack: Flying hits all three, Fire hits Breloom, and Poliwrath at half HP after the Drum dies to any strong neutral hit.

plan: Runerigus burns physical threats while Omastar Shell Smashes into fast coverage. Mega Slowbro gives the team a slower Calm Mind endgame without reversing Omastar's speed advantage. The reserves extend that opening: Relicanth supplies Head Smash.
crack: Dark and Ghost hit Runerigus and Slowbro, Grass quadruples on Omastar, and Taunt stops the Room and the boosts.

plan: Luis's Mantine Surfs into Water Absorb Lanturn while setting Tailwind, and Speed Boost Sharpedo snowballs beside them. The reserves extend that opening: Arctovish supplies Freeze Dry.
crack: Electric hits Mantine and Sharpedo, Grass hits Lanturn and Sharpedo, and the Tailwind runs out in four turns.

plan: Beverly's electric reef: Pincurchin sets Electric Terrain for Surge Surfer Alolan Raichu's Fake Out and Psychic, and Merciless Toxapex crits every poisoned target. The reserves extend that opening: Quagsire supplies High Horsepower.
crack: Ground hits Pincurchin and Raichu, Psychic and Ground hit Toxapex, and Toxapex does nothing to a Steel or Poison type.

plan: Imani's doubles: Sniper Kingdra crits after Focus Energy, Competitive Milotic Hazes and Recovers, and Swanna Hurricanes. The reserves extend that opening: Golduck supplies Hydro Pump.
crack: Dragon and Fairy hit Kingdra, Electric and Grass hit Milotic, and Rock or Electric ends Swanna.

plan: Josue's storm: Drizzle Pelipper and Prankster Tornadus stack Tailwind and Taunt under rain, Gulp Missile Cramorant and Wind Power Kilowattrel fire perfect Hurricane and Thunder.
crack: Electric and Rock hit every bird, Ice hits Tornadus, and both the rain and the Tailwind expire if the player weathers the first turns.

plan: Andres's fossils: Choice Band Rock Head Relicanth Head Smashes and Armaldo Swords Dances. The reserves extend that opening: Omastar supplies Shell Smash; Bastiodon supplies Stealth Rock.
crack: Grass hits both, Fighting hits Relicanth, and Water hits Armaldo.

plan: Kyla's doubles: Sheer Force Nidoqueen and Choice Scarf Cloud Nine Golduck. The reserves extend that opening: Toxapex supplies Venoshock; Milotic supplies Hydro Pump.
crack: Ground and Psychic hit Nidoqueen, Electric and Grass hit Golduck, and Golduck is locked into one move.

plan: Darrin's full rain team: Drizzle Politoed Icy Winds, Swift Swim Kingdra, Ludicolo and Barraskewda outspeed everything, Wash Rotom burns, and Mega Gyarados's Mold Breaker Waterfall ignores Water Absorb.
crack: Electric hits five of six, Grass hits four, the rain lasts five turns, and Gyarados's Dragon Dance turn is a free turn for Ice or Electric.

plan: Tony's Emergency Exit Golisopod First Impressions and leaves, Thick Fat Dewgong Freeze-Dries and Encores, and Floatzel Wave Crashes. The reserves extend that opening: Empoleon supplies Hydro Pump.
crack: Electric hits all three, Rock hits Golisopod, and Fighting hits Dewgong.

plan: Denise's Swanna sets Tailwind for Lightning Rod Seaking's Drill Run and Water Absorb Quagsire's Yawn. The reserves extend that opening: Toxapex supplies Venoshock.
crack: Electric hits Swanna and Quagsire cannot be hit by it, so use Grass for Quagsire and Rock for the birds and fish.

plan: The siblings share one plan: Mega Launcher Clawitzer pulses, Adaptability Dragalge fires Draco Meteor, and Dazzling Bruxish blocks the player's priority. The reserves extend that opening: Dracovish supplies Fishious Rend.
crack: Electric and Grass hit Clawitzer and Bruxish, Dragon and Psychic hit Dragalge, and Bruxish's Dazzling stops only priority.

plan: Camron's doubles: Natural Cure Starmie and Water Absorb Arctovish with Fishious Rend. The reserves extend that opening: Dewgong supplies Muddy Water; Golisopod supplies First Impression.
crack: Electric and Grass hit both, and Arctovish is slow so Fishious Rend rarely doubles.

plan: Tara's Sniper Seadra crits after Focus Energy, Sheer Force Feraligatr Liquidations, and Thermal Exchange Arctibax cannot be burned. The reserves extend that opening: Milotic supplies Hydro Pump.
crack: Electric and Grass hit the Water pair, Fighting and Steel hit Arctibax, and Seadra needs a free turn.

plan: Missy's doubles: Unaware Pyukumuku Toxics and stalls, then Skill Link Cloyster Shell Smashes. The reserves extend that opening: Seaking supplies Waterfall; Kingdra supplies Focus Energy.
crack: Taunt or Steel ends Pyukumuku's plan, and Electric, Grass or Fighting ends Cloyster.

plan: Carolina's doubles ace run: Unburden Hawlucha sheds its White Herb after Close Combat, Intimidate Luxray pivots, and Mega Gardevoir's Pixilate Hyper Voice and Calm Mind close. The reserves extend that opening: Kommo O supplies Iron Defense.
crack: Flying, Ice and Electric hit Hawlucha, Ground hits Luxray, and Steel or Poison walls Gardevoir.

plan: Cory's doubles: Static Stunfisk Yawns and Water Absorb Poliwrath Close Combats. The reserves extend that opening: Lanturn supplies Hydro Pump; Vikavolt supplies Thunderbolt.
crack: Grass and Ice hit Stunfisk, Electric and Grass hit Poliwrath, and both are slow.

plan: Charlie's doubles: Wailord Water Spouts at full HP and Sniper Octillery covers four types. The reserves extend that opening: Starmie supplies Hydro Pump; Inteleon supplies Snipe Shot.
crack: Electric and Grass hit both, and Wailord's Water Spout weakens with every point of damage.

plan: Duncan's deck crew: Mega Machamp uses Power Fists to drive reliable punches into Special Defense, Thick Fat Walrein Encores, and Steelworker Dhelmise anchors. The reserves extend that opening: Decidueye supplies Spirit Shackle.
crack: Flying and Psychic hit Machamp, Fighting and Electric hit Walrein, and Fire or Flying ends Dhelmise.

plan: Kira and Dan run two pairs: Plusle and Minun Nuzzle and Helping Hand, and Solrock's Weakness Policy and Lunatone's Power Herb Meteor Beam swing the fight.
crack: Ground hits the Electric pair, Dark, Ghost and Water hit the meteorites, and Solrock's Policy only triggers on super-effective hits.

plan: Jani's doubles: Shed Skin Dragonair Dragon Dances, Simipour Nasty Plots, and Choice Band Furret Double-Edges. The reserves extend that opening: Bibarel supplies Swords Dance.
crack: Ice and Fairy hit Dragonair, Electric and Grass hit Simipour, Fighting hits Furret, and Taunt stops both setup moves.

plan: Garrison's shipwreck: Galvanize Alolan Golem's Double-Edge is Electric, and Sturdy Carracosta Shell Smashes. The reserves extend that opening: Relicanth supplies Head Smash; Armaldo supplies X Scissor.
crack: Ground quadruples on Golem, Grass hits both, and Carracosta after a Smash falls to any strong hit.

plan: Demetrius's doubles: Scrappy Stoutland bites Ghosts and Motor Drive Electivire punches. The reserves extend that opening: Magnezone supplies Thunderbolt; Lanturn supplies Thunderbolt.
crack: Fighting hits Stoutland, Ground hits Electivire, and neither can take repeated hits.

plan: Thalia's elegance: Flower Veil Florges Wishes, Queenly Majesty Tsareena blocks priority, and Liquid Voice Primarina spreads Water Hyper Voice. The reserves extend that opening: Gardevoir supplies Psychic.
crack: Steel and Poison hit the fairies, Fire and Flying hit Tsareena, and Electric or Grass drops Primarina.

plan: David's Protean Greninja changes type every move, Water Compaction Palossand wants to be hit by Water, and Competitive Empoleon Icy Winds. The reserves extend that opening: Sharpedo supplies Crunch.
crack: Electric and Grass hit Greninja, Grass and Water hit Palossand (Water is the trap), and Fighting or Electric hits Empoleon.

plan: Alice's doubles: Galarian Corsola burns and Strength Saps, Skill Link Cloyster Shell Smashes, and Adaptability Crawdaunt Swords Dances. The reserves extend that opening: Kingdra supplies Focus Energy.
crack: Dark and Ghost hit Corsola, Electric and Grass hit the other two, and Taunt stops both setup moves.

plan: Austina's Simple Bibarel Swords Dances to plus four while Ice Face Eiscue Belly Drums behind its ice. The reserves extend that opening: Simipour supplies Hydro Pump; Walrein supplies Hydro Pump.
crack: Fighting and Electric hit both, and Taunt or a fast hit ends the setup turns.

plan: Carter's Dragon Dance Whiscash, Choice Scarf Strong Jaw Dracovish and Assault Vest Lanturn all punish the player for being slow. The reserves extend that opening: Gyarados supplies Waterfall.
crack: Grass quadruples on Whiscash and hits Lanturn, Dragon and Fairy hit Dracovish, and Fishious Rend halves if Dracovish moves second.

plan: Mel and Paul's bug garden: Prankster Illumise sets Tailwind and Encores, Volbeat can pass Tail Glow into Mega Butterfree's accurate Hurricane, and Dustox offers a second setup threat.
crack: Rock, Fire and Flying pressure the bugs; Taunt disrupts setup and Baton Pass. Compound Eyes improves Hurricane accuracy but does not bypass resistances.

plan: Daisy's garden in the sun: Cherrim sets it and Helping Hands, Chlorophyll Deerling doubles its speed, and Roselia Sleep Powders. The reserves extend that opening: Gloom supplies Sleep Powder.
crack: Rain or Rock ends the sun, Fire and Flying hit every flower, and Grass types ignore the Sleep Powder.

plan: The twins are growing up: Togetic Follow Mes and paralyzes, Competitive Wigglytuff spreads Hyper Voice, and Mega Alakazam's Trace and Psychic end things fast. The reserves extend that opening: Blissey supplies Soft Boiled.
crack: Steel and Poison wall the fairies, Dark and Ghost hit Alakazam, and spread moves ignore Follow Me.

plan: Miguel's pets: Wonder Skin Delcatty Fake Outs and paralyzes, and Intimidate Stantler Psyshield Bashes. The reserves extend that opening: Lickitung supplies Body Slam; Munchlax supplies Body Slam.
crack: Fighting hits both, and neither has the bulk to take a real hit.

plan: Rhett's doubles: Sturdy Sawk Bulk Ups and Throh throws. The reserves extend that opening: Pawmo supplies Mach Punch; Grapploct supplies Octolock.
crack: Flying and Psychic hit both, and Sawk's Sturdy breaks on chip damage.

plan: Expert Timothy's Trick Room: Dusclops sets it and burns, Thick Fat Hariyama and Guts Conkeldurr punch first inside it, and Mega Ampharos's Draco Meteor and Thunderbolt finish.
crack: Ghost and Dark hit Dusclops, Flying and Psychic hit the fighters, Ice and Fairy hit Ampharos, Taunt stops the Room, and Protect burns its turns.

plan: Mixed Lucario and Choice Scarf Defiant Passimian apply immediate pressure; Leek Sirfetch'd threatens repeatable Close Combat with Flying and Grass coverage. The reserves extend that opening: Scrafty supplies Fake Out.
crack: Flying and Psychic hit all three, Fire hits Lucario, and Passimian is locked into one move.

plan: Jaiden's Speed Boost Ninjask Baton Passes into Aftermath Skuntank. The reserves extend that opening: Drapion supplies Cross Poison; Accelgor supplies Final Gambit.
crack: Rock and Fire hit Ninjask, Ground hits Skuntank, and Taunt breaks the pass.

plan: Munkidori applies Choice Specs pressure with a chance to poison through Toxic Chain, Jynx threatens sleep, and Musharna supports their speed with Thunder Wave and their bulk with Light Screen. The reserves extend that opening: Chimecho supplies Psychic.
crack: Ground and Ghost hit Munkidori, Fire and Steel hit Jynx, Dark hits Musharna, and Steel types ignore Toxic Chain.

plan: Perry's birds: Skill Link Toucannon, Super Luck Unfezant sets Tailwind, and Tinted Lens Decidueye's Spirit Shackle traps. The reserves extend that opening: Staraptor supplies Brave Bird.
crack: Rock and Electric hit every bird, Fire hits Decidueye, and the Tailwind is four turns.

plan: Chester's Mandibuzz sets Tailwind and Taunts, Effect Spore Vileplume Sleep Powders, and Sheer Force Braviary Brave Birds. The reserves extend that opening: Fearow supplies Drill Peck.
crack: Rock and Electric hit the birds, Fire and Flying hit Vileplume, and Grass types ignore the powder.

plan: The Magikarp salesman's revenge: Sash Magikarp Flails, Feebas Hypnotizes, Choice Scarf Ditto copies your best, then the fish he actually trained show up: Competitive Milotic and Mega Gyarados.
crack: Laugh at the first three, then respect Electric and Grass for Milotic and Gyarados, and note that Ditto copies your Pokemon with only five PP per move.

plan: The TV crew's second interview: Loudred has become Exploud, Sturdy Magnezone Electrowebs, and Chatot sets Tailwind. The reserves extend that opening: Unfezant supplies Brave Bird.
crack: Fighting hits Exploud, Fire and Ground hit Magnezone, Rock and Electric drop Chatot.

plan: Hitmontop's Intimidate, Fake Out and Wide Guard buy Volcarona a Quiver Dance window, then Feint breaks protection for Heat Wave. The reserves extend that opening: Durant supplies Iron Head; Yanmega supplies Bug Buzz.
crack: Single-target Rock coverage bypasses Wide Guard, while Taunt and special pressure contest the setup window.

plan: Leavanny slows active opponents with Electroweb and threatens Leaf Blade. Galvantula supplies accurate Thunder and pivoting while Mega Heracross brings Skill Link multihit pressure. The reserves extend that opening: Vespiquen supplies Attack Order.
crack: Fire and Flying hit all three, Flying types ignore the Web, and Heracross is slow before the Web lands.

plan: Taylor's Ribombee Quiver Dances behind Vivillon's Rage Powder and Sleep Powder while Water Bubble Araquanid Wide Guards. The reserves extend that opening: Pinsir supplies X Scissor.
crack: Fire and Flying hit the bugs, Electric hits Araquanid, and Grass types or Safety Goggles ignore the powders.

plan: Doug's Intimidate Masquerain Quiver Dances behind Ariados's Rage Powder and Sticky Web, and Tinted Lens Lokix First Impressions. The reserves extend that opening: Orbeetle supplies Light Screen.
crack: Rock, Fire and Flying hit every bug, and Flying types ignore the Web.

plan: Greg's Ledian sets both screens and Tailwind for Escavalier's Swords Dance. The reserves extend that opening: Leavanny supplies Leaf Blade; Galvantula supplies Thunder.
crack: Fire hits both, Rock hits Ledian, and Brick Break or Defog clears the screens.

plan: Kent's Speed Boost Ninjask Baton Passes into Moxie Pinsir while Intimidate Vespiquen holds the line with Attack Order. The reserves extend that opening: Kilowattrel supplies Thunderbolt.
crack: Rock and Fire hit all three, Flying hits Pinsir, and Taunt stops the pass.

plan: Ranger Jackson runs Tapu Koko from Route 110: its Electric Terrain powers Surge Surfer Alolan Raichu, Fan Rotom rides above it, and Regenerator Tangrowth Stun Spores.
crack: Ground blanks the Electric core, Fire and Ice hit Tangrowth, and the terrain lasts five turns.

plan: Ranger Catherine's rain: Forecast Castform sets it and Weather Balls, Infiltrator Noivern Hurricanes, Hydration Goodra Thunders, and Swift Swim Seismitoad spreads Muddy Water.
crack: Electric and Rock hit Castform and Noivern, Ice and Fairy hit Goodra and Noivern, Grass quadruples on Seismitoad, and the rain is five turns.
